name: application-equalizer-sliders
title: Equalizer Sliders
description: Vertical band-gain sliders with frequency and dB labels for audio equalizer controls, in native-slider and fill-bar variants.
useWhen: Vertical band-gain sliders with frequency and dB labels for audio equalizer controls, in native-slider and fill-bar variants.
avoidWhen: Avoid equalizer sliders when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Equalizer Sliders uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
